Assembly Floor concurrence vote on SB 100 (08/28/18); Gabriel listed among the Ayes, an earlier Assembly term in the same legislature.

rows.reasoning: Gabriel voted Aye on the Assembly Floor (08/28/18) for SB 100 (2017-2018), which requires retail sellers to procure eligible renewable energy resources reaching 44 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030 — a renewable-procurement mandate with firm deadlines, matching 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines.'
